hero.tagline: A scam message is easy to miss. A one-second check is not.

scamCheck.heading: Scam Check
scamCheck.body: Paste a suspicious message and know in seconds if it is trying to trick you.

qrDecoder.heading: QR Decoder
qrDecoder.body: See whether a QR code sends money out or brings money in, before you tap.

onDevice.heading: On-Device
onDevice.body: Nothing you paste ever leaves your phone. The check runs locally, not on a server.

hindiEnglish.heading: Hindi-English
hindiEnglish.body: Reads scam messages written in mixed Hindi and English, the way they actually arrive.

learn.heading: Learn As You Go
learn.body: Every verdict explains the scam pattern behind it, so you recognize it next time.

bridge.heading: The pause before you pay.
bridge.body: Every UPI scam relies on you acting before you think. PayPause puts one moment of clarity between a suspicious message and your money.
bridge.stat1dd: Indians targeted by digital payment scams annually
bridge.stat2dd: of your message content sent to any server

bazaar.heading: Check like forwarding to a friend.
bazaar.body: Share a suspicious message to PayPause the same way you forward it to someone you trust. One tap, no accounts, no signup.

FAKE_REFUND_QR.headlineScam: This QR code will send money out of your account, not receive it. Do not scan.
FAKE_REFUND_QR.explanation: FAKE REFUND QR — The scammer told you to scan to receive money, but the QR code initiates an outgoing payment.

KYC_PHISHING.headlineScam: This link is asking for bank login details. Real banks do not do this.
KYC_PHISHING.explanation: KYC PHISHING — A fake message threatening account block steals credentials via a phishing form.

OTP_SOCIAL_ENGINEERING.headlineScam: Do not share your OTP with anyone. It authorizes a transaction you did not agree to.
OTP_SOCIAL_ENGINEERING.explanation: OTP SOCIAL ENGINEERING — A caller or message asks you to read out an OTP under the pretence of verification.

FAKE_PAYMENT_SCREENSHOT.headlineScam: Do not confirm delivery based on this screenshot. No payment was made.
FAKE_PAYMENT_SCREENSHOT.explanation: FAKE PAYMENT SCREENSHOT — A fabricated screenshot claims payment was sent to pressure a seller.

CUSTOMER_CARE_IMPERSONATION.headlineScam: This is not a real contact from your bank or UPI provider.
CUSTOMER_CARE_IMPERSONATION.explanation: CUSTOMER CARE IMPERSONATION — A fake number or message poses as your bank to steal credentials.

UNKNOWN.headlineScam: This message may be suspicious. Proceed with caution.
UNKNOWN.explanation: UNKNOWN PATTERN — No known scam category matched, but remain cautious.
